label: copy phase: input 1/h while outputting h/1 (mid-late recall)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never in the original or delimiter steps), and only when the fed-back input is 1 or h (59% / 41% of mass) and is a repeat occurrence. The output is almost always h (81% of mass) or 1 (13%), so the feature tracks the 1->h / h->h / 1->1 bigram being reproduced during copying. The rate grows with recall position: it is silent at recall_idx 0-1, weak at 2, and strongest at 3+. Strongest activations are input 1 -> output h (for example ...y 1 h... copied back), and the activation on a following h->h step is smaller. It does not fire on other input tokens, on 1/h inputs followed by other outputs (except weak firing when the output is 0 or m), or early in the copy. Precision is limited: many early-position 1/h -> h/1 transitions (recall_idx 3) stay silent.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=1 (+7.30), phase=2 & in_tok=h (+6.72), in_tok=1 (+4.87), in_tok=h (+4.72), phase=2 & out_tok=h (+4.47), out_tok=h (+4.32). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.94), prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.91), recall_idx=1 (-3.91), out_tok=o (-1.88).
